holderNote: Nexus Mutual Safe — a KPK-managed account. Owns 5 StakingNFT positions across 5 pools.
discovery: StakingNFT is mint-only (no burn) with totalSupply=280 globally and no per-owner enumeration; the adapter scans tokenInfo descending over totalSupply..1 for owner==account (balanceOf guard skips non-stakers and early-exits stakers; no fixed scan cap). No off-chain agent. Cross-checked vs a Transfer(to=safe) event scan, which yields the same {180,184,185,186,187}.
legsNote: One Staking (activeStake+expiredStake) + one Rewards leg are emitted PER position (per tokenId), keyed by positionId = abi.encode(address stakingPool) (StakingViewer.stakingPool(poolId)); the StakingNFT tokenId is a display-only entry in PositionBalance.labels (labels = ['Staking','<pool>','NFT #<id>']). The amounts below are the SUMS across all 5 positions (what the no-arg balance getters return and what the per-NFT legs add back up to).

legsAggregate.name: Staked NXM (active + expired stake, summed across 5 positions)

groundTruth: StakingViewer.getAggregatedTokens([180,184,185,186,187]) at forkBlock = (totalActiveStake 74229519750529478080348, totalExpiredStake 0, totalRewards 228254616240628948835).
